Before I ask you to choose

First, remember
how we became us.

I don't want to ask you to decide our future without looking honestly at the story that brought us here. We did not become a couple in one moment. We arrived here through months of friendship, countless conversations, happy memories and a year that was not always easy.

01
Before there was an “us”

We started as friends.

For around six or seven months, we were best friends and something a little more. We talked for hours, sometimes almost the whole day. PUBG, teasing, random conversations and sharing the little details became part of our routine.

02
6 November 2025

Then we chose each other.

The friendship became a relationship. You became my person, and I became yours. The date matters to me, but what mattered more was that we were finally giving a name to something that had been growing between us for months.

03
The beautiful side of our year

We made memories worth keeping.

The long talks, our PUBG days, the little jokes, the way I wanted to tell you everything, and moments like holding hands at Crumble and Packages Mall. There were days when being together felt easy, warm and exciting.

04
The difficult side of our year

We also hurt each other.

There were arguments, misunderstandings, and moments when we both felt unheard. We both had days when we felt hurt, disappointed, or unsure how to reach each other. Sometimes what one of us meant was not what the other felt; sometimes frustration spoke before understanding could. I do not want to turn this into a list of who was right or wrong. I want to acknowledge that this year was difficult for both of us, and that both of our feelings deserve to be heard.

05
What this year has shown me

Love is also how we handle the hard days.

I don't want to pretend the good moments cancel out the difficult ones. I want to learn from both. I know a healthier relationship would need honesty, patience, communication and effort from both of us, not just beautiful words from me today.

I am not asking you to ignore the parts that hurt you, or to choose me because of how long we have known each other. I want you to look at the real story, not an edited version of it.
Now I want you to think about our future

After seeing the friendship, the love, the mistakes and the reality of this year, can you see yourself building a life with me? Can you imagine choosing the real me, while we both keep learning how to love each other better?

You don't have to answer this page. Just think about it honestly. I want your decision to come from what you truly feel, not from guilt, memories or pressure.

Why I keep
coming back.

If you don’t fight for what you love, then don’t cry when you lose it.

That's why, even when we're upset with each other, I keep wanting to come back and talk. Not because I think love means ignoring the hurt, and not because I expect you to forget what happened. I come back because I still care, because I don't want anger to be the only thing that gets the final word, and because I believe two people can try to understand each other when they both genuinely want to.

You are so beautiful that I could fall in love with you a thousand times, even if every single time I had to love you quietly, from a distance.

To me, you are not just someone I want beside me on the easy days. You are someone I want to learn to understand on the difficult ones too. I am not asking you to choose a perfect story. I am asking whether you still want to write a real one with me.

With love, Amjad ♡

A letter I want you to understand · From Amjad

About what happened, Hassaneh.

And about that thing which happened and which caused all this, I want to tell you one thing, Hassaneh. If I could knowingly lie to you with the intention of hiding something from you or choosing not to tell you, that would go against the love I have for you. I never want to make a habit of keeping parts of my life away from you.

I always get concerned about how something might make you feel. Even in small things, whether we are playing PUBG, when you ask me about breakfast, or when something means saying no to you, going against what you want is one of the hardest things for me. I care deeply about your feelings, sometimes so much that I start worrying about how even a small thing might hurt you.

With that situation, I want you to understand something, Hassaneh: the thing itself was not a big deal to me. What mattered to me was how you might feel. I kept thinking about whether it would hurt you or make you feel that I had kept something from you. I was so concerned about your feelings that I overthought the moment and made the wrong decision. I thought I was avoiding hurt, but I understand now that keeping it to myself could hurt you more.

And I want you to think about this too: one day, I want to tell you everything about my life myself. I want to share the ordinary details, the difficult things, the little stories and everything that makes up my days. So how could I intend to hide this from you as though I wanted to keep it a secret forever? I cannot imagine building a life with you while deliberately keeping important things away from you. I want to be able to come to you and tell you myself, because living beside you while hiding something from you is not the kind of life I want.

I know saying this now does not undo the hurt or prove everything instantly. I should have told you openly at the time, and I am responsible for that choice. I want my future actions to show you that you can hear things directly from me, without having to wonder what I have left unsaid.

I should have trusted you with the truth in the first place, instead of deciding on your behalf how you might feel about it.

Even ten years from now, I hope I can ask you the same question: do you know how much I care about you, and how much thought I put into the things that might hurt you? I don't want you to have to guess. I want you to feel it in the way I speak to you, the way I treat you, and the way I show up every day.

If there is something important in my life, I want to be able to tell you. I want you to know my routine, the ordinary conversations, where my day takes me and the little things that happen. I want the same openness between us, freely shared by both of us, because we trust each other enough to speak honestly and comfortably.

I cannot prove all of this with a paragraph. You will understand it through the way I live, the choices I make and the consistency I show over time. I know that trust is not rebuilt by asking you to believe a promise today. It has to be earned through my actions.

I want you to know the whole of me, honestly. — Amjad ♡

One little thing I want us to understand · From Amjad

One little thing I want us to understand.

I know you choose me, and I have never wanted to doubt that. But there was one thing that felt a little odd to me, even though I understand it might have come up in a moment of anger. The thought of us becoming just friends again, or possibly considering someone else and moving on if we ever found someone better, felt a little strange to me.

I am not bringing this up to make you feel bad about something you said. I just want you to understand how I see it. When I think about us, I do not think of two people staying together until they find someone better. I think of two people who have found someone they want to keep choosing, even while they grow, change and discover new things about each other.

I want to be your person, just as you are mine.

The person you feel at home with.

I want us to have the comfort of knowing that neither of us is looking elsewhere whenever things get difficult or life feels a little less exciting. I want to be the person you run to when you are sad, the one you share your happiest news with, and the one you can be completely yourself around. Not because you have to, but because that is where you feel happiest.

And about getting bored, I do not think loving someone means doing the same things every day for the rest of our lives. I want to keep dating you, discovering new places, making you laugh, trying new things, surprising you and finding little ways to make ordinary days special. There will always be something new for us to experience together.

Even on difficult days, we remain a team.

I know we will not always agree, and there will be days when understanding each other takes more effort. But I want us to talk, listen, make things right and give each other the patience we deserve. I do not expect perfection from either of us. I just want us both to keep putting love and effort into what we have.

And that is really all I wanted to clarify. I am not asking you to choose me again as if you have not already. I know you, and I know the place we have in each other’s hearts. I just want us to share the same understanding that what we are building is something we want to nurture, protect and keep choosing.

I do not want a life where we keep wondering if someone better is out there. I want a life where we keep discovering how much more beautiful ours can become. — Amjad ♡

A few things I never want you to forget · From Amjad

I am lucky to have you.

Out of all the people this world has created, all the roads I could have taken, and all the lives I could have lived, somehow our paths crossed. Maybe it was timing, maybe it was one of those little miracles life gives us, but I got to meet you. And if I spent the rest of my life searching for a word greater than lucky, I still do not think it would be enough to explain what you mean to me.

If I had to choose one beautiful coincidence from my life, it would be finding my way to you.

Please never ask me to do less for you.

And one little promise I want from you: never say, “You already do so much for me,” as a reason for me to stop. Always tell me to do more for you. Ask me for the little things, the big things, the affection, the time and the effort. I want to keep showing up for you, and I want you to feel comfortable asking. Your happiness is not a burden I want you to apologise for. Let me love you in all the ways I can.

Let us understand each other, not just react.

There is something else I want us to promise each other. If either of us has a problem with someone in the other person's life, let us be understanding enough to give each other’s feelings value, whoever that person may be and whatever the situation is. I do not want either of us to feel that we have to fight just to be heard.

Let us listen first, try to understand why something is uncomfortable, explain our own feelings gently and then work out what feels fair for both of us. We may not always see things the same way, but we can still respect what matters to each other. I want us to solve things together, not turn them into a fight between us.

Your feelings matter to me, and mine should matter to you. Let us make room for both.

That is the kind of love I want us to keep building: one where we can ask freely, give wholeheartedly, speak honestly and understand each other with care.

I am grateful that, out of all the lives I could have lived, I get to share this one with you. — Amjad ♡

The kind of love I want us to keep building · From Amjad

I want us to feel safe with each other.

I want to know the little things about your day too, even the normal conversations you have with your colleagues and the ordinary moments you might not think are worth mentioning. Not because I want to monitor you or expect you to report every interaction, but because I want us to feel comfortable sharing our worlds with each other. I want that openness to go both ways, so neither of us ever feels that everyday things have to be hidden.

When jealousy shows up, let us reach for each other.

If either of us ever feels jealous or uncomfortable about someone, please do not let it turn into a fight. Take my hand, look at me and ask me gently about it. I will listen, explain and reassure you. I promise to do the same for you. Whoever the person is, let us choose honesty and reassurance over accusations, assumptions or anger. I want us to feel that we can talk about uncomfortable feelings without being made to feel silly for having them.

The best kind of reassurance is not a fight won. It is a heart made to feel safe, heard and loved.

Let us protect what belongs to us.

I want the personal things between us, especially our disagreements and difficult moments, to be treated with care. Let us talk to each other first and not turn our private matters into casual conversations or gossip. I do not want outside opinions to become louder than the two people actually living this relationship. And if either of us genuinely needs advice or support, we can choose someone trustworthy and respectful. Asking for support does not make us weaker; what matters is that we handle our relationship with care and respect.

Pinky promise me one thing.

Whenever things get hard, please come and talk to me. I would rather hold you while you cry until my shirt is soaked with your tears than have you feeling that you have nobody. You do not have to pretend to be okay with me. Bring me your worries, your fears, your unfinished thoughts and even the days when you do not know what to say. I want to be beside you through all of it, and I want you to know you can always reach for me.

I want to kiss your forehead in public, your neck when we are alone, and your worries away whenever life becomes too much.

I have no intention of loving you halfway. I want to be present in the ordinary conversations, gentle in the difficult ones, patient when we misunderstand each other and wholehearted in every way I love you. Let us keep making each other feel that we are not alone in this.

Your safe place, your biggest listener and your person. — Amjad ♡
